verdict.rationale: The evidence shows orchestration primitives: deployable ETL pipelines "for data orchestration" via Lakeflow and Spark, a versioned Jobs REST API, and SQL alerts that automatically monitor query results and send notifications. That implies job automation, but no item documents recurring schedules or triggers. missing for 10: explicit documentation of cron/recurring schedules and triggers for jobs or workflows, AI-native setup of schedules (e.g. via Genie Code), independent or hands-on corroboration of scheduling.
